go:422961.title: GATE DA 2024 | Question: 1
go:422961.question:

  4. Both (i) and (ii) are false

$J(u)=\frac{u^{T} S_{B} u}{u^{T} S_{W} u}$

Note: $\mathbb{R}$ denotes the set of real numbers.

  2. $S_{W} u^{*}=\lambda S_{B} u^{*}$
  3. $S_{B} S_{W} u^{*}=\lambda u^{*}$
  4. $u^{* T} u^{*}=\lambda^{2}$
